title: "Dinheiro" trends amid reports of circular investment and AI deals
description: Recent reports discuss how money circulates between AI giants, with specific deals mentioned by sources.

sections.heading: Circular Investment and Bubble Fears
paragraphs: According to G1, there is a concept of "circular investment" where money circulates between AI giants. This circulation is reported to be feeding fears of a new bubble.

sections.heading: Reported Financial Agreements
paragraphs: Jornal Primeira Página reports that Nvidia and SK Group have closed a deal worth $500 billion for infrastructure and memory. In contrast, TradingKey reports on a $750 billion deal involving Nvidia, SK Group, and OpenAI.

sections.heading: Market Accusations
paragraphs: TradingKey reports that Nvidia has been accused of "circular financing" regarding the deal. The source also indicates that the market is in a state of panic.
